title: Location 1 Meridian Market

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: You came! And my mom didn't. This could NOT be going better.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You came! And my mom didn't. This could NOT be going better.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: It all kicks off here! Hey, did you bring those galactic cocktails? Or do you have some uppers maybe? A wee vial of Joos? I'm fucking nervous about this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It all kicks off here! Hey, did you bring those galactic cocktails? Or do you have some uppers maybe? A wee vial of Joos? I'm fucking nervous about this.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Eh, it doesn't matter. I guess I'm free wheeling this one on the stone colds. Ah well, at least I got an anxiety high. And I'm still hungover, so maybe I can taste last night's gin on the way back up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, it doesn't matter. I guess I'm free wheeling this one on the stone colds. Ah well, at least I got an anxiety high. And I'm still hungover, so maybe I can taste last night's gin on the way back up.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Hey, thanks for coming through. For reals. I'm going to start in a minute. Let me just cough up some phlegm, then I'm clear to address the crowds.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, thanks for coming through. For reals. I'm going to start in a minute. Let me just cough up some phlegm, then I'm clear to address the crowds.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Yeah. What? It doesn't matter where the people are? The words will find them, if I find the right words.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. What? It doesn't matter where the people are? The words will find them, if I find the right words.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: You sayers! Always with the naying. We'll see.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You sayers! Always with the naying. We'll see.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Well about that. I was thinking you could help me a bit. A sort of call-and-response affair.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well about that. I was thinking you could help me a bit. A sort of call-and-response affair.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: It's easy! Basically, after every statement I make, you shout out... something. Like "YEAH!" or "PREACH!" or "WE WON'T BE SILENCED!" or "OLIVE NEK IS THE FUTURE!"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's easy! Basically, after every statement I make, you shout out... something. Like "YEAH!" or "PREACH!" or "WE WON'T BE SILENCED!" or "OLIVE NEK IS THE FUTURE!"

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Just let your heart speak, ok? Right... Fuck. Let's just get this done. Olive Nek speaking tour, part 1. Meridian Market. Let's go! ...You ready?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just let your heart speak, ok? Right... Fuck. Let's just get this done. Olive Nek speaking tour, part 1. Meridian Market. Let's go! ...You ready?

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: COMPANIONS! THANK YOU FOR COMING TO HEAR ME SPEAK. YOU ALL KNOW ME AS OLIVE NEK, REVOLUTIONARY, BON VIVANT AND ICONOCLAST! I'M HERE TO MAKE MY STAND TODAY!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: COMPANIONS! THANK YOU FOR COMING TO HEAR ME SPEAK. YOU ALL KNOW ME AS OLIVE NEK, REVOLUTIONARY, BON VIVANT AND ICONOCLAST! I'M HERE TO MAKE MY STAND TODAY!

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: ...That's not really... anyway. Let's keep this moving.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...That's not really... anyway. Let's keep this moving.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: THIS IS JUST THE BEGINNING! I'M SPREADING THE WORD THROUGH ALL OF NIVALIS. JOIN ME ON MY TOUR AS WE LIGHT THE FLAMES OF CHANGE AND BURN THE SYSTEM TO THE GROUND!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: THIS IS JUST THE BEGINNING! I'M SPREADING THE WORD THROUGH ALL OF NIVALIS. JOIN ME ON MY TOUR AS WE LIGHT THE FLAMES OF CHANGE AND BURN THE SYSTEM TO THE GROUND!

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: No... The system. It's... burn the... system.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No... The system. It's... burn the... system.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Alright, that's Meridian Market done and the tour is off to a great start. Thanks for the help. That was... pretty good, for the most part.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, that's Meridian Market done and the tour is off to a great start. Thanks for the help. That was... pretty good, for the most part.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Now I'm off to get blindy before Hive Mall. Will you join?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now I'm off to get blindy before Hive Mall. Will you join?

nodes.text: Is this part of your tour?

nodes.text: I don't think that's how it works.

pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't think that's how it works.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't think that's how it works.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll shout out my OWN response.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll shout out my OWN response.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: PEOPLE OF MERIDIAN MARKET, IT'S TIME TO CAST OFF THE SHACKLES OF CORPORATE OPPRESSION AND EMBRACE A NEW WAY. A BETTER WAY.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: PEOPLE OF MERIDIAN MARKET, IT'S TIME TO CAST OFF THE SHACKLES OF CORPORATE OPPRESSION AND EMBRACE A NEW WAY. A BETTER WAY.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: I'M OLIVE NEK, AND I'M THE HARBINGER OF CHANGE. CLING ON TO HOPE PEOPLE OF MERIDIAN! AND MARCH WITH ME ON THE NEXT STEP TO LIBERATION. I'LL SEE YOU ALL AT HIVE MALL!
